I would love to see a Bayonetta type game infused with Germanic, Norse, Celtic, Slavic and Christian mythology.

Set the game in the period where Christianity was taking over Scandinavia.

Take the cutesy bumbling ne'er do well girl who means well trope from anime and make her a Valkyrie. She earned her position through dying gloriously taking out some attacking Christian invaders. This is of course the tutorial level.

A big part of the game would be two layers of visuals, the spiritual plane and the realm of men. In the realm of men soldiers fight and die, and they do so in response to how well things are going in the spiritual plane. As the player combos up higher the Norse do better in their fight against the crusading incursion, and as the enemy does better the Christians do better.

At the core of the game our hapless failure of a Valkyrie is trying to rescue a soul that was stolen from his rightful home in Valhalla. Storywise this would be conveyed by her being sent in the first mission to secure the soul of some great viking warrior who is surrounded and doomed to die, as she fights her way to the location there is very little direct opposition, mostly just enemies rushing by because they will only fight where there is a conflict between the followers of their respective religions. When she gets to him she has to fight off waves of enemies that progressively get harder and harder until she loses. Then as she moves to him some priest performs last rights and he is executed, and thus the angels take his soul with them.

She wakes later to wallow in her failure and decide she is a bad enough dude to rescue the great viking. She then goes from battlefield to battlefield defeating Divine Lieutenants, various archangels, to secure the magic McGuffins she needs to open the gates to Heaven.

In her various battlefield fights she can gain strength by inspiring faith, the more her combos and the less she is hit the better the Norse will do, and thus the greater their faith will become. Allowing her to gain additional strength and do even better. She will also have the ability to directly use faith to perform miracles, healing, magical attacks and such... But that is at the expense of her long term viability as that prevents her leveling up as much as she may wish.

So, she gets her McGuffins and enters Heaven. From there she must progress through various crazy cloud levels without the human combat being overlaid, until she has defeated the four bosses. Jesus, the Holy Ghost, Yahweh... And then the Holy Host, all three blended together.

I admit there are flaws to my idea, but I think it would be a cool to have a mix of Odin's Sphere and Bayonetta.
